topic: Day 145 — reel — Contentment isn't the absence of desire, it's peace with the present while you pursue more
text:
Wanting more
and being at
[peace] aren't
opposites.
caption:
Contentment isn't the absence of desire, and ambition doesn't require being unhappy where you are. Both can run at once.
